description: A local, browser-only CSV dashboard for reviewing deletion_requests.csv. No backend, cloud services, authentication, or database. The workspace has no policy, source-system evidence, ground truth, or audit rules; compliance is unevaluated and reported statuses are unverified.

questions.question: Which language should the website use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Adds static typing to JavaScript and is well suited to maintainable web applications.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Uses standard browser JavaScript without a separate type system.

questions.rationale: A browser-only frontend can read a user-selected CSV without a backend or persistent data store.

questions.rationale: The requested deliverable is a website; no framework preference was provided.

questions.question: What should the website do? Please confirm or edit the conservative starting scope.
questions.recommendedChoice: Build a local, browser-only dashboard that lets a user select deletion_requests.csv, inspect and search/filter its records, and view descriptive summaries of the CSV's reported fields. audit_claims=false: do not produce audit or compliance verdicts, do not label records as ghost data, and do not imply reported_status is verified. Display compliance as Unevaluated and reported status as Unverified until applicable policy and supporting source-system evidence are provided. Do not upload or persist CSV data.
questions.answer: Build a local, browser-only dashboard that lets a user select deletion_requests.csv, inspect and search/filter its records, and view descriptive summaries of the CSV's reported fields. audit_claims=false: do not produce audit or compliance verdicts, do not label records as ghost data, and do not imply reported_status is verified. Display compliance as Unevaluated and reported status as Unverified until applicable policy and supporting source-system evidence are provided. Do not upload or persist CSV data.
questions.rationale: User-confirmed local CSV dashboard scope and audit_claims=false. Only deletion_requests.csv is available; policy, source-system evidence, ground truth, and audit criteria are absent.
